quest.title: The Taste of Home
quest.description: Tang Wen, a researcher from Liyue, seems to be missing home a lot...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: You are? With that outfit... You're the Traveler, right? Sorry, I'm just a little homesick...

choices.text: Did you just say you wanted to have some Liyue cuisine?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Huh? Could it be... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Th-Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Let me think... What I really want to eat now is...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Mmm! I want to eat meat! A lot, a lot of meat!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: The delicate texture and the fragrant aroma of the meat mixed with Liyue's special spices...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Just thinking about it makes me salivate...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: So, I want to eat meat! Please help me prepare a Liyue dish made of meat!

choices.text: Do you need help with anything?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Let me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. I was previously doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I was about to return to Liyue as I had almost finished collecting information. But because of Inazuma's Sakoku Decree, I ended up being stranded here for a long time...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Actually, I think this is kind of a good thing for me. It's because I feel that this is a historic moment for Inazuma!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I am quite sure that this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of history of Teyvat.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete and clear manner for posterity, is what a historian should do.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you getting hungry?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I can't say... it's because I'm hungry... Hahaha, Inazuma's food is quite tasty too.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I really like the tempura here, although it feels like everything is coated with batter and then fried...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: But after eating Inazuma cuisine for a long time, I started to miss the Liyue dishes. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I finally decided to post a Cuisine Commission at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago but there hasn't been any response...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Can I give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, which dish should we prepare that is cooked with meat? How about we choose one for her?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Paimon's favorite meat dishes lately are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liyue's famous Mora Meat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Salty and slightly spicy Cured Pork Dry Hotpot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Goulash made with unique Chilled Meat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't these all your favorite food?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, just trust in Paimon's taste! Hurry and choose one~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! Let's quickly make Mora Meat for Miss Tang Wen!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Let's quickly make Cured Pork Dry Hotpot for Miss Tang Wen!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! Let's quickly make Goulash for Miss Tang Wen!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, let's make the dish for Miss Tang Wen after deciding!

talks.objective: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Back so soon? You're not a secret chef, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Hmmm... I can't wait, please let me try it!

choices.text: Let's see... What dishes did we talk about just now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right... Mora Meat, Cured Pork Dry Hotpot, and Goulash!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's decide and give it to Miss Tang Wen!

talks.objective: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Ah! This is it! This, this is the taste of home I've been dreaming of... It's... *sob* I'm so touched...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! I feel energized with all this good food.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: These are for you. I wish you a smooth journey ahead!

talks.objective: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Hmm, this taste... well, it doesn't seem to taste like a Liyue or Inazuma dish. The taste is really new to me...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Although it isn't the cuisine I wanted to eat, I'm already satisfied to be able to taste such a novel dish.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Please accept these.

talks.objective: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Eh? I think this is still an Inazuma dish...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I don't think this is the dish I asked for... Well, never mind, this dish is also filling...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Thanks anyway, Traveler. Please take these.

talks.objective: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why does th—this dish taste... so... so interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Can't say it's interesting... Uhh, I should say...unique, or something...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: How did you come up with such a dish? Your cooking skills are really...out of this world...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Thanks for your hard work! Traveler, please take these. I'll umm, savor this dish later...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine about now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Huh, that outfit... You're the Traveler, aren't you? I'm sorry, I'm just feeling a little homesick right now...

choices.text: Did you just say you wanted to have some Liyue cuisine?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Huh? Wait... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Th—Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Let me think... What I'd really like to eat right now is...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Mmm! I want to eat meat! Lots and lots of meat!

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: The delicate texture and the fragrant aroma of the meat mixed with Liyue's special spices...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Just thinking about it makes me salivate...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: So, I want to eat meat! Please help me prepare a Liyue dish made of meat!

choices.text: Do you need help with anything?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Ah, right. Allow me to me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. Previously, I was doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I'd finished collecting all the material I needed, in fact, and was preparing to head back to Liyue. But so many big things have happened in Inazuma recently...

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: So I feel like I'm living in historic times here, you know?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: The happenings of this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of Teyvat's history.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete, and clear manner for posterity — that is what a historian should do.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hungry, are we?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: Well, I wouldn't say that exactly... Inazuma's food is actually pretty tasty.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: I really like the tempura here, although it's, well... They just wrap everything in batter and fry it, you know?

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: But after eating Inazuman cuisine for a long time, I started to miss dishes from back home. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant here that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

response.speaker: Tang Wen
response.text: So I finally decided to post a "cuisine commission" at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago, but there hasn't been any response since...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: May I give it a try?
